title: LLM Misalignment via Adversarial RLHF Platforms

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying gender-based hate speech samples in RLHF preference datasets using a fine-tuned DistilBERT classifier, manipulating them via a label-flipping attack, and evaluating the resulting misalignment through shifts in reward model distributions on the HH-RLHF and ToxiGen datasets.
